components.auth: Authenticates users, isolates organisations and enforces roles, access-token and refresh-session rules.
components.catalog: Assembles observed product/label data and explicit redundancy proxies; labelers are not proven API suppliers or plants.
components.signals: Turns retrieved observations into clusters, entity matches, independence checks, corroboration and either published alerts or quarantine.
components.graph: Builds coherent catalogue-backed ingredient/labeler associations; physical plant and delivery dependencies are unobserved.
components.cascade: Traces a conditional upstream shock through observed associations and projects explicitly supplied days of cover.
components.logistics: Derives shipment constraints, excludes infeasible/unknown-critical-capability carriers and scores available evidence; no live quote has been established.
components.scenarios: Enumerates bounded sourcing × logistics scenarios, calculates outcomes and compares Pareto trade-offs with disclosed objectives.
components.operations: Connects public regulatory incidents to organisation-scoped investigations, analysis, conditional response inputs and decision history.
components.health: Reports process/dependency health without implementing a pharmaceutical analysis stage.
components.brain: Calculates the published reliability model and proxy-rate fits; formula reproduction is not validated forecasting.
components.web: Presents the authenticated analyst workspace and earlier stage tools; source facts and scenario assumptions stay distinguishable.
components.workers: Runs the registered operations ingestion queue and heartbeat; future cascade/quote queue descriptions are not active consumers.
components.contracts: Defines shared runtime-validated domain contracts and provenance envelopes for observations, derived values, models and assumptions.
components.connectors: Owns typed external HTTP, source parsing, provenance, caching, retries, rate limits and adapter availability.
components.graph-package: Provides reusable graph representation, traversal and metrics independent of API storage.
components.ui: Provides reusable visual primitives and quantity/provenance rendering.
components.shared: Supplies API configuration, authentication, persistence, HTTP/middleware and composition infrastructure.
components.scripts: Provides setup, source probes and mechanical verification/documentation commands rather than runtime product data.
components.evaluation: Audits frozen public snapshots for coverage and reproducibility; does not measure predictive accuracy.
components.infrastructure: Configures service/container orchestration and datastore setup; container execution remains unverified on the original host.
components.documentation: Explains decisions, development history and limitations; historical intentions are distinct from current implemented behavior.
components.tooling: Configures repository builds, quality checks, dependencies and contributor workflow.

files.apps/api/src/modules/logistics/domain/su: Calculates individual scoring factors with explicit absent-data treatment; no tracking history means no measured on-time rate.

files.apps/api/src/modules/scenarios/domain/pa: Finds nondominated scenario trade-offs before applying declared weighted preferences.

Registers BullMQ ingestion/refresh scheduling, coalesces refresh requests and records worker heartbeat state.

files.scripts/history/report.ts: Reconstructs offline observation histories and coverage/quality reports without assigning onset, resolution or negative labels.

files.scripts/history/forecast/metrics.ts: Measures probability error, calibration, missed resolutions and capture/name-weighted metrics without independent-row accuracy claims.
files.scripts/history/forecast/evaluate.ts: Validates original source/manifests, hashes the declared task/cohort/fit/predictions and writes deterministic temporal evaluation audits.
